title: Directory listing is on for /backup/
summary: The web server lists the contents of /backup/, which hands an attacker a map of files that were never meant to be browsed.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Index of /") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Turn off automatic directory listing (Options -Indexes, or autoindex off).
